text:
maria: quick postmortem follow-up 1: the incident where TLS handshakes degraded under cross-region failover looks like a routing-propagation + SNI tag mismatch that caused client retries to pile up and saturate LB CPU. need owners for remediation and a short playbook.
dan: saw the same pattern in the controller logs 1: some newer routes missed the sni_tags label and were landing on default certs, causing TLS renegotiation. pcap + logs: https://redwood.internal/forensics/1775000000
rachel: impact summary: 12% increased TLS handshake time, healthcheck failures in 2 regions, and automatic failover amplified traffic to eu-west-1 which hit our LBs' connection limits. this matches a recurring pattern (similar to 3 earlier incidents).
tom: immediate mitigation suggestions?
maria: short list: 1) emergency routing rule rollback for the staging-to-prod propagation that introduced the missing label. owner: @dan. target: 6h. 2) LB connlimit increase + temporary per-route connection caps in affected regions. owner: @tom. target: 12h. 3) healthcheck backoff tuning to avoid cascading fails during mass retries. owner: @rachel. target: 48h. 4) long-term: ensure controller validates SNI labels on create/update and reject risky changes; add e2e for cross-region rollout. owner: platform-sre. target: 2w.
dan: opened NET-4876 for the rollback and added steps + approval checklist. patch command ready: `kubectl rollout undo rs/route-controller-deploy -n routing --to-revision=3`
rachel: created NET-4877 for healthcheck tuning and wrote proposed probe config. snippet:
```
healthcheck:
  interval: 10s
  failures_before_alert: 6
  backoff: exponential
  max_backoff: 60s
```
tom: bumped LB connlimit on eu-west-1 as a stopgap, changed per-route caps: `lbctl set-capacity --region eu-west-1 --route default --conn-limit 25000` 1: watch CPU and we should scale autoscaler if CPU > 70%.
deploy-bot: action: rollback requested by dan at 2025-10-02T14:08:10Z. status: in-progress.
monitor-bot: alert: tls-handshake-latency spikes suppressed by manual cap at 2025-10-02T14:12:45Z.
dan: rollback completed, controllers at rev 3. rolling restart to reapply cert labels. status: success.
maria: thanks. please document any downstream teams to notify (CDN, edge-configs). also add the incident as a recurring pattern check on the monthly networking trend board.
platform-sre: starting the controller validation patch as NET-4901, PR opened: https://git.redwood/platform/PR/2568 1: acceptance includes an e2e that simulates cross-region rollouts and verifies SNI tags. ETA: 14 days.
rachel: adding synthetic TLS handshake probes across regions to detect reconnection/regression early. probe spec on PR: https://git.redwood/probes/789. owner: @rachel. target: 72h to promote to prod.
tom: will follow up with autoscaler team to pre-warm nodes for eu-west-1 and add a temporary scale override for 48h. ticket: INFRA-4120.
maria: final owner summary for tracking: dan (rollback + route remediation, 6h), tom (LB caps + scale overrides, 12h), rachel (healthcheck backoff + probes, 48-72h), platform-sre (controller validation + e2e, 14d). i'll consolidate into the postmortem board and run weekly check-ins until fixes are verified.
dan: note: potential downstream action for CDN team to confirm origin cert selection during failover, cc: @cdn-team in NET-4876.
maria: next sync 2025-10-03 10:00 UTC. please post short status updates here when you hit milestones. closing thread after final verification and trendboard update. :white_check_mark:
